In Postgres GREATEST returns NULL if any argument is NULL, so the ON CONFLICT update can leave or regress lastIngestedJsonlTimestamp to NULL (e.g., when existing or EXCLUDED is NULL, such as attachments-only updates), defeating the intended watermark advancement.
